title: Harden web viewer entity display names
summary: Fix the web fallback viewer so supported-app exports whose components or views omit a name field still render, sort, search, and inspect through stable fallback labels instead of failing with a localeCompare error.
acceptance_criteria: The web viewer builds one shared display label for components and views from name, title, label, route, id, or another stable source.
Review queues, component cards, view cards, inspector titles, search, and graph labels use the shared fallback instead of directly assuming name is present.
A HumbleControl supported-app export loads in the web viewer without the Load failed localeCompare error.
Repository ticket, fallback, and workflow checks record the fixed viewer behavior.

trigger.source_ref: Jan asked to continue and fix the component design display after the HumbleControl embedded Studio viewer showed a localeCompare load failure.
trigger.note: Keep this as a viewer robustness fix; do not mutate the HumbleControl export only to satisfy one field assumption.

agent_notes: Observed in the embedded HumbleStudio iframe at /apps/humble-control/studio/?studio=design while loading the HumbleControl supported-app export.
